text:
amy_marketing: Quick sync: planning to announce Catalyst next Wed 09:00 PT. Need final changelog link, staging docs URL, a one-line benchmark nugget for the hero, canary/ramp windows, and who is demoing the webinar (30m). Also two email subject lines for A/B test. :calendar:

kai_eng: I'll post the changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/710 (sha `f2b4c9e`). Canary plan: 09:00 PT canary 5m, 25% at 09:05, 60% at 09:12, full at 09:30. Fallback tag: catalyst-legacy. Ops will standby for 20m after full.

sylvie_docs: Staging docs up at https://docs.redwood.dev/staging/catalyst. I'll add the migration quickstart and a short hero sentence. Marketing: paste canonical link into the announcement when ready.

omar_research: Benchmark blurb suggestion: "Catalyst reduces per-token cost up to 2.5x on long-context workloads and cuts p95 latency by ~50% at 16k tokens." I'll run a final overnight regression and confirm the exact numbers by 07:30 PT tomorrow; if anything shifts we should use "up to" language. :bar_chart:

amy_marketing: Great. Webinar: Evan, you lead? We want 30m same day at 11:00 PT. Email to go ~5m after full rollout, VIP at +10m, social at +20m. Two subject options: A) "Catalyst: Faster long-context, lower token cost" B) "Meet Catalyst — up to 2.5x lower token spend"

ev an_pm: I'll lead the demo. Sylvie will show migration, Omar covers benchmarks in Q&A. I'll own the runbook/rollback and upload it here.

kai_eng: Runbook snippet: rollback `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/reinference --to-revision=12`. Post-deploy checks: `curl -sS https://health.prod.redwood.dev/model-route | jq .p95` and KV cache hit-rate check. Add post-rollout smoke to validate p50/p95.

sylvie_docs: Migration snippet (to paste in docs):

```
# catalyst example config
model:
  id: redwood-catalyst
  quant_mode: auto
  kv_cache: enabled
```

omar_research: Regression queued; will confirm final hero stat by 07:30 PT. If confirmed I'll add one short sentence suitable for the blog hero.

release-bot: Scheduled deployment: release-catalyst start=1730000000 canary_window=300s full_rollout=1730001800 CI: checks passed. :white_check_mark:

amy_marketing: Proposed timeline: 09:00 PT canary start, 09:30 full, 09:35 blog + docs live, 09:40 public email (A/B), 09:45 VIP email, 09:50 social posts, 11:00 webinar. I'll draft the announcement and drop it here by EOD for review. Final checklist: merged changelog, staging docs URL, benchmark confirmation, runbook + rollback, webinar deck, email subjects. Ping here with any last changes. :rocket:
